sections.title: Factors That Affect Your Jeevan Labh Premium

items: Age of Policyholder: The younger you are, the lower your premium.
Sum Assured: A higher coverage amount means a higher premium.
Policy Term: Longer terms generally have slightly lower annualized premiums but are paid for more years.
Mode of Payment: Yearly payments are cheaper than monthly payments due to 'modal loading'.
Riders: Optional add-ons like Accidental Death Benefit increase the cost.
High Sum Assured Rebates: LIC offers a discount on higher sum assured amounts, which our calculator includes.

content.text: Jeevan Labh offers significant tax advantages under the Exempt-Exempt-Exempt (EEE) category, a key reason for its popularity.

items.title: Section 80C Deduction (Investment Phase)
items.body: The premium you pay each year (up to â‚¹1.5 Lakh) is eligible for deduction from your taxable income. Example: If your annual premium for a â‚¹10 Lakh Jeevan Labh plan is â‚¹42,000 and you are in the 30% tax bracket, you can save approximately â‚¹12,600 in taxes each year.

items.title: Section 10(10D) Tax-Free Maturity (Return Phase)
items.body: The entire maturity amountâ€”including the Sum Assured and all bonusesâ€”is completely tax-free, provided the annual premium does not exceed 10% of the sum assured. Example: If your maturity value is â‚¹23 Lakh, you receive the full amount without any tax liability. This offers a significant advantage over instruments like Fixed Deposits where interest is fully taxable.

content.text: Jeevan Labh provides liquidity options after you have paid premiums for at least two full years, at which point the policy acquires a 'Surrender Value'. This value is crucial for both policy surrender and loan eligibility.

items: Guaranteed Surrender Value (GSV): This is calculated as a percentage of total premiums paid (excluding riders) plus a percentage of vested bonuses.

Loan Facility: You can take a loan against the policy, with the maximum amount being up to 90% of the surrender value for in-force policies. This provides access to funds without terminating the plan.

sections.title: LIC Jeevan Labh Benefits at a Glance

items: Pay for Less, Get for More: The key benefit is the limited premium payment term. For a 25-year policy, you only pay for 16 years.
Dual Advantage: It combines life insurance protection with a disciplined savings plan, ensuring a lump sum at maturity.
Tax Efficiency: Premiums paid are deductible under Section 80C, and the maturity amount is tax-free under Section 10(10D).
Liquidity Options: Loan and surrender facilities are available after two full years of premium payments.
